CustomField.description: Written by: call 2. Read by: the one-for-one-for-one arithmetic, and every read that needs the words behind an identification. The self-lookup that makes the ledger two rows. Null on a Located row and required on an Identified row, enforced in the trigger. A pair never points at another Identified row: the ledger is two rows deep and never a chain. SetNull rather than Restrict because the platform refuses a restricting self-lookup; the delete law in AAO_PairTriggerHandler is the actual guard, and it refuses the delete outright.
CustomField.label: Located Pair
